stem: The battery charge of a delivery drone, as a percent of a full charge, \(m\) minutes after takeoff is modeled by \(B(m) = 100(0.97)^{m}\). According to the model, what is the battery charge, to the nearest percent, 10 minutes after takeoff?
solution: With a calculator, \(0.97^{10} \approx 0.7374\), so \(B(10) \approx 73.7\), which rounds to \(74\%\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This subtracts \(3\%\) of the full charge ten times, \(100 - 10(3)\). Each minute removes \(3\%\) of the current charge, so the losses shrink.
explanation.B: Incorrect. \(97\%\) is the charge after only 1 minute, \(B(1)\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. \(30\%\) is \(10 \times 3\%\), the total loss if the decrease were a constant \(3\) percentage points per minute, not the remaining charge.

verify:
b = 100*Rational('0.97')**10
assert round(float(b)) == 74
assert value(choices[answer]) == Rational(74, 100)
assert all(value(choices[k]) != Rational(74, 100) for k in choices if k != answer)
